programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486287/attempts/1eb91fd6574841ae8e00d1bb94d07e69/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ys = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    xs = [c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    top, bottom, left, right = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
    mid_r = (top + bottom) // 2
    mid_c = (left + right) // 2
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        # The marker identifies its matching interior corner and the diagonal opposite.
        corner_r = 0 if r < top else 1
        corner_c = 0 if c < left else 1
        for qr, qc in ((corner_r, corner_c), (1-corner_r, 1-corner_c)):
            r0, r1 = (top+1, mid_r) if qr == 0 else (mid_r+1, bottom-1)
            c0, c1 = (left+1, mid_c) if qc == 0 else (mid_c+1, right-1)
            for rr in range(r0, r1+1):
                for cc in range(c0, c1+1):
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
